statement_summary: Program uses CPG 2.0 baseline and SP 800-82 Rev. 3; documented
Security officer designated; OT owners accountable; monthly IT/OT meeting
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment, including after acquisitions
Risk acceptance authority; no occupant-safety risk above Low
Quarterly reporting to the audit committee
Annual policy and standard review
Written, time-limited exceptions
Vendor security addendum before access; 72-hour notice; no standing OT remote access
Annual reassessment of Tier 1 vendors
AI and new platform features approved before enabling
Annual independent assessment; annual IT penetration test; passive OT assessment
Life-safety separation; read-only hardwired points only
Acquisition due diligence and isolation until assessed
Five-year retention of security records and no-harm determinations
Sanctions
Unique accounts, including on building systems; documented exceptions
Role-based least-privilege access with approval
MFA for all and for all remote OT access; security keys for administrators
Same-day identity provider disable; local accounts and badges within 24 hours
Prior-role access removed within 5 business days of transfer
Quarterly access reviews; no more than 6 platform administrators
Tenant credentials: written authorization; 90-day suspension; quarterly recertification
Separate privileged accounts; break-glass accounts tested quarterly
Integrator remote access only through the gateway, approved per session and recorded
16-character passwords; defaults changed before connection
Lockout, failed-login alerts, screen lock
Video export limited to named investigators; quarterly video access review
IR plan and runbooks for OT ransomware and access platform incidents
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Log incidents with discovery time
Severity 1 activates the crisis management team within 2 hours
Occupant safety first; no controller resets without the OT safety lead
Breach determination and decision log with determination date; kept 5 years
Notices per the P08 matrix; counsel confirms
Insurer hotline before vendors are engaged
Ransom decision rule with OFAC check
Voluntary report to CISA and the FBI within 24 hours of a severity 1 declaration
Annual exercises per runbook with executives, counsel, chief engineers, and SCC
BAACS contingency plan; degraded-mode procedures; quarterly restore tests
Lessons learned within 30 days
Owner assigns classification and records it in the inventory
Encryption of Restricted and Confidential data; recorded OT exceptions
Card data only in P2PE terminals; never written down or emailed
Retention minimums: visitor ID images 30 days; video 30 days; access history 1 year
Disposal by cross-cut shredding, certified destruction, or erasure
Building security information shared only under contract
No biometric data without COO approval after P10; notice, opt-in, deletion
No Restricted or Confidential data in unapproved AI tools; no-training clause
Legal hold overrides retention
Business use of company and building systems
Acknowledgment at hire and annually; integrator rules of behavior
Annual training; OT role-based training; card handling training
Screen lock
No software installs or USB storage; integrator media scanned
Only managed devices on building system networks
Report anything unusual immediately
Approved AI tools only; human review of outputs
Video and access data for security and operations only
No audio recording without General Counsel approval
